claims.claim: Canonical RESULT or FAILURE publication emits one operational attention identity bound to terminal kind, RUN id, and artifact commit SHA without changing terminal authority.
Attention executes reviewed published-main workflow code, validates the terminal binding, and creates or reuses a strictly bounded terminal-attention Issue.

Exact replays are idempotent, while competing terminals and conflicting attention identities fail closed; legacy resolver fixtures may still construct malformed competing-terminal snapshots without weakening production enforcement.
Attention delivery remains subordinate to canonical terminal truth and can be replayed without triggering execution or changing RESULT/FAILURE state.
Attention carriers and Issue content contain only inert selectors and make no semantic, execution, approval, verification, or publication claims.
Existing AIOS lifecycle and transport behavior remains compatible, with production terminal-attention behavior unchanged by this repair.
The repair is committed, limited to the authorized test fixture surface, and has no unresolved items.
